brief: The canvas simulates a translucent screen upon which illuminated shadows appear. Various stylized figures, mimicking traditional Indonesian puppets, move across the surface from within. These shadows are defined by rich, saturated colors projected onto a darker background. The visual focus is on the play of light and silhouette, creating depth and dramatic movement. The user interacts by dragging the mouse across the screen, which controls the position and movement of the featured shadow puppets. This input guides the narrative action, making the shadows appear to dance and interact with the environment, creating a continuous theatrical performance.
statement: This sketch creates an immersive theatrical experience on a translucent screen where illuminated shadows dance and interact with light. Inspired by traditional Indonesian shadow puppetry, it features stylized figures that move autonomously across the canvas, responding to user input through mouse dragging. The visual narrative emphasizes dramatic silhouette play, rich saturated colors against a dark background, and fluid motion that brings the shadows to life in an ever-changing performance.
